model.threshold_source: 5th percentile of cached ImageNet validation ID scores
model.interpretation: Score decomposition and local ID-match maps; not causal attribution or calibrated OOD probability.

explanation: Layer weights average binary expert membership divided by subset size across five routers. Weighted layer scores sum to the score. Centering those terms on the fixed ensemble threshold sums to its margin. This is arithmetic attribution, not causal evidence.
selection_note: Selected to illustrate a fixed-threshold decision contrast; not an unbiased sample or aggregate performance estimate.
case_explanation: This ImageNet validation image belongs to the folding-chair class. The final-layer baseline rejects it; the routed intermediate-layer evidence keeps it above Voyager’s threshold.
